name: repo-agent-guide
body: The apg repository's own agent guide `AGENTS.md` (present in the graph as a scanned File): the repo-level guidance agents read when working in this checkout. It sits outside the `opencode-suite/` distribution (installed `apg init` embeds the suite via `include_str!`, while this guide is repo-local), so it is modelled separately from `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance`. It carries the file-tool guidance ("Other tools"; the "Read those files with read, grep, or bash" line) that states the same graph-first qualifier as the installed navigator prompt, and the same in-graph / out-of-graph artifact-class boundary.
